column1: # Pinned wiki revisions — the reviewed baseline the references/ content tracks.
# Format: <page title (underscored)> TAB <pinned revid> TAB <revision timestamp> TAB <pinned on>
# A MediaWiki oldid permalink is immutable: api.php?action=parse&oldid=REVID
# always serves exactly this revision, regardless of later edits to the page.
# Maintained by scripts/wiki-drift.sh: run it to compare these pins against the
# live wiki; review any drift, fold what matters into references/, then re-pin
# with --update. Never point the skill at the live page as an authority — see
